name: RM-718

lead: RM-718 is an experimental drug from Rhythm that activates the MC4R pathway of appetite regulation, designed for weekly dosing.
It is in an early phase 1/2 study in healthy volunteers and people with hypothalamic obesity or Prader-Willi syndrome.

paras: Not approved; no published safety results were located.

trials.title: A Study of RM-718 in Healthy Subjects and Patients With MC4R Pathway Impairment

lead: RM-718 is an investigational melanocortin 4 receptor (MC4R) agonist developed by Rhythm, described as a weekly-dosed compound. [1] A phase 1/2 study of RM-718 in healthy subjects and in patients with MC4R pathway impairment, including hypothalamic obesity and Prader-Willi syndrome, began in March 2024 with 111 participants. [1]
It is not approved. No published results were located, and the only source is the trial registration.

paras: NCT06239116 is a phase 1/2 study (n=111, active not recruiting) in healthy subjects and patients with hypothalamic obesity or Prader-Willi syndrome. [1] No published results were found, and no studies were found for cosmetic use.
